entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane of adventurers and ruins, now beset by the Roil, the Worldwake and the returned Eldrazi.

entities.name: The Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient world-devouring beings from beyond the edges of the world, awake again on Zendikar and eating its people and gates.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: A greater Eldrazi whose inner life is called sentient but unfathomable to human minds.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: A greater Eldrazi served by artisans.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: A greater Eldrazi with crushers in its service.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: A realm-warping force that has long made mapping Zendikar nearly impossible.

entities.name: The Worldwake
entities.description: Zendikar's reaction to something dire approaching, in which land elementals and zendikons swallowed expeditions.

entities.name: The levelers
entities.description: Adventurers who stand against the Eldrazi, growing from neophytes into heroes as mana is poured into them.

entities.name: Venerated Teacher
entities.description: An old master who tells his long-trained students that they are now prepared to wage war against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Rendius, Lighthouse Chronologist
entities.description: A name suggested for a fully-leveled leveler hero.

entities.name: Kirena, Tuskcaller of Kazandu
entities.description: A name suggested for a fully-leveled leveler hero.

entities.name: Mtemke, the Lord of Shatterskull Pass
entities.description: A name suggested for a fully-leveled leveler hero.

events.summary: The old master tells his students that the reason for their training is now clear: the Eldrazi threat has come, and they must wage war against them.
events.quote: Now you wage war against the Eldrazi, and show them what beings of this world are capable of.

events.summary: The Worldwake: Zendikar rages at the approach of something dire and expeditions are swallowed by land elementals and zendikons.
events.quote: Expeditions became swallowed by land elementals, zendikons, and other hunks of revenge-thirsting terrain.

events.summary: The Eldrazi arrive on Zendikar, killing people where they stand and leaving no safe pockets of civilization.
events.quote: Instead of simply failing to return from dangerous safaris in exotic wildernesses, people are being snuffed where they stand.

events.summary: Adventurers abandon treasure hunting and prepare to fight the Eldrazi, with the levelers rising to stand against them.
events.quote: Rise of the Eldrazi 's "levelers" are adventurers who've taken it upon themselves to stand up against the Eldrazi.

events.summary: With the Eldrazi already eating the gates, someone pumps Zendikar's heroes full of mana to rush their growth.
events.quote: So someone—perhaps a handful of ancient teacher-types, perhaps planeswalkers, perhaps Zendikar itself—is pumping the world's heroes full of mana to rush the process.

events.summary: Flashback: thousands of years ago the Eldrazi first awoke from torpor and nearly destroyed the natural world while humanoids did not slow them.
events.quote: Thousands of years ago when the Eldrazi first awoke from their torpor, the destruction was vast; the natural world nearly perished at the touch of a tentacle.

relations.note: Levelers are adventurers who stand against the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Rise of the Eldrazi 's "levelers" are adventurers who've taken it upon themselves to stand up against the Eldrazi.

relations.note: He addresses the students he trained over the years.
relations.quote: you who stayed with the school, you who've trained with me all these years
Humanoid races of every stripe are becoming food for ancient annihilators that their world barely remembered.
